findings.message: Code fetches data over the network when it runs (websave). What the server returns today may differ from what the authors got; a receipt must record each file fetched and its SHA-256.
Requires Dynare (free) inside MATLAB or Octave, with no version named; a rerun must choose one and log it.
Requires Matlab; the desk says it has it.
3 file reads use paths built at run time (macros, globs, variables), so triage could not check that those inputs exist.
The documentation mentions restricted data ("proprietary") but every input triage could trace is present. Check by hand that no restricted file is read through a path triage could not resolve.

Documentation names MATLAB toolboxes: Datafeed Toolbox, Econometrics Toolbox, Machine Learning Toolbox, Optimization Toolbox, Parallel Computing Toolbox. Each is licensed separately; check the desk's MATLAB has them.
Non-commercial licence. Rerunning for an editorial check is normally fine; a receipt should not redistribute the package's files.
